$janet.$comment: Not JSON Schema. Read by scripts/Test-OutputContracts.ps1, which is the point of the file living here rather than being generated from the return type.
$janet.$comment.contract2: 1 -> 2 on 2026-09-03: items gained 'area', the stored project label that show and report can now be narrowed by. A field added to the envelope is a format change, so the number moved and so did the surface below.
$janet.$comment.contractField: The envelope stamps 'contract' and the gate cross-checks it against the number above, so code and schema cannot drift apart in either direction. The older thread envelopes carry no such field -- they are pinned by recorded goldens instead -- which is why this one differs from its own family.
$janet.$comment.notShow: Deliberately NOT the thread_show envelope. Show carries items[].notes in full and is asserted byte for byte against output recorded from the pre-shim PowerShell, which the golden generator extracts out of git and re-runs -- so it cannot grow a field without a declared correction. This is a separate format beside it, which is why it needed no correction at all.

contract.description: Bumped only by a format change. An engine change that moves this number is a mistake in one direction; a format change that does not is a mistake in the other.

count.description: Items in this answer. Excludes completed items unless all=true was passed.

active.description: Topic in focus, or null. Nothing active is an ordinary state, not a fault -- do not read null as an error.

notesLength.description: Total characters of note body NOT carried by this envelope, summed across items. Present so the omission is stated rather than implied: an envelope that silently dropped the notes would look complete.

error.description: A list that could not be read, reported in-band because this runs in the startup path. It is a fact about the list, not a failure of the call: a reader that ignores it sees an empty list, which is the honest degraded answer rather than a wrong one.

area.description: Which project or area this item belongs to. A STORED label, never derived from the topic: splitting topics on their first colon was measured to produce 12 groups for 16 topics and to split single projects across several. Always present and never empty -- an item with none reads as the literal '(unfiled)', which is one real group rather than a guess at which project it resembles. Narrow to it with the report's own 'area' selector.

topic.description: Identity. Items are addressed by topic, as a dictionary -- position was removed on 2026-08-14 because the display hides completed items while an index counted into the unfiltered file.

status.description: Focus is single: at most one item is active.

refs.description: research.json node ids. Context that earned a node, as opposed to notes, which is detail too small or too fresh to be worth one.

next.description: The resume cursor: the one thing to do first on return. Carried in FULL, never truncated -- it is the field the report exists to deliver, and abbreviating it would defeat the purpose.

notesLead.description: First NON-EMPTY line of the notes, trimmed, capped at 200 characters with a trailing ellipsis when cut. First non-empty rather than first, because notes built by appending begin with a blank line.

notesLength.description: Full size of this item's notes in characters, whether or not any of it is shown. This is how a one-line note is told from a five-day log without carrying either.
